title: Vegetable Pakora
description: Mixed vegetables dipped in a spiced gram-flour batter and deep-fried until crisp — the classic rainy-day teatime snack.

ingredients.name: Spinach
ingredients.notes: roughly chopped, or substitute another leafy green

steps: In a large bowl, combine the besan, rice flour, carom seeds, red chilli powder, turmeric and salt.
Add the sliced onion, potato, chopped spinach, green chillies and ginger to the dry mixture, and toss well so the vegetables are coated.
Add water a little at a time, mixing until you get a thick batter that clings to the vegetables — it should not be pourable like a pancake batter.
Heat oil in a deep pan or kadhai over medium heat. Test the temperature by dropping in a small bit of batter — it should rise steadily without browning too fast.
Drop spoonfuls of the vegetable-batter mixture into the hot oil, a few at a time, and fry for 4-5 minutes, turning occasionally, until deep golden and crisp.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve hot with mint or tamarind chutney.
